General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
Does your tailgate rattle and make a loud noise when it is closed? If so you probably need this!
This is the Suzuki OEM Tailgate/Rear Gate Cushion.
This cushion installs directly above the latch in the rear gate opening.
This is an easy DIY fix that will suppress your tailgate noise.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 Tailgate Cushion
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
